NewsArticle.Title: New Features
NewsArticle.Content: Dark Ages adds several features during beta test - Religions - Politics - Guilds - Love - Portraits - Bulletins - Herbalism - Treasure Chests - Elemental Nodes - Martial Forms - Smithing - Tailoring - Mentoring - Enchantment - Research See [screenshots](http://www.darkages.com/2000/pics/index_feature.html) and descriptions of these features and more.
